failedChecks: The supplied standalone alias-invocation search does not support the claim that every alias form was audited. Its regex misses the previously identified valid forms `yarn run jira`, `pnpm run jira`, quoted forms such as `npm run "jira"`, and option-bearing invocations. The unrestricted `kstack-jira.mjs` scans cannot detect those alias-only consumers.
materialDissent: I do not accept the packet's conclusion that the round-15 alias-search gap is closed: the displayed command retains the same material omissions, despite the narrative claiming broader coverage.
review.recommendation: Revise the audit evidence with a repository-wide, known-positive-validated search that demonstrably matches quoted, option-bearing, `run`/`run-script`, npm, yarn, pnpm, and npm-run-all alias invocations; then repeat the whole-file intersection between those matches and status-branching idioms. No production-code change is indicated by the supplied evidence.
review.strongestObjection: The definitive consumer-audit conclusion depends on alias coverage, but the only displayed standalone alias regex still fails known-valid alias forms explicitly identified in round 15.
